value.rationale: Quantifies a normatively important feature of robust social choice with genuinely competing constituency winners: an exact condition for when a compromise option obtains probability, and a phase transition that forces selection of the unique pooled Condorcet loser. The parameter margins correspond to real strict-ballot profiles, so this is more than a formal signed-matrix artifact. It clarifies the fairness/robustness trade-off and usable radius calibration beyond numerical individual-instance LP solutions.
